title: Master-agreement netting and segregated collateral
summary: Cross-contract set-off is a legal evidence question, not a portfolio convenience. Segregated initial margin remains outside close-out netting and returns through an exact custodian transfer lifecycle.
invariants: Netting requires exact counterparty, master agreement, currency, governing law, legal opinion and close-out-netting election.
Gross receivables/payables remain visible when one legal net cash amount is settled.
A member of a fixed netting set cannot settle individually.
Cross-counterparty or cross-master-agreement convenience netting fails without mutating member state.
Segregated IM is not silently netted and is not returned until custody settlement; acknowledgement alone is insufficient.

provenance.claim: Dispute/finalization, exact master-agreement netting and segregated IM custody-return semantics.
